description:
Render the interactive rates card for Landhaus Prägant, Bad Kleinkirchheim, Austria.

Same lookup and same result as get_rates() (identical text output) — call
this one when the user wants to SEE a visual rates table, typically right
after get_rates() already confirmed there's something worth showing.

Args: identical to get_rates() — see that tool for full parameter docs.
name: render_rates_card
title: Show Rates Card
